ck_agent_team_assignments_scope.name: ck_agent_team_assignments_scope
ck_agent_team_assignments_scope.value:

            WHEN 'global'  THEN "agent_team_assignments"."team_project_id" IS NULL
            WHEN 'project' THEN coalesce("agent_team_assignments"."team_project_id" = "agent_team_assignments"."project_id", false)
            ELSE false
          END

ck_agent_workflow_run_steps_handoff.name: ck_agent_workflow_run_steps_handoff
ck_agent_workflow_run_steps_handoff.value:
CASE "agent_workflow_run_steps"."handoff_state"
            WHEN 'none'     THEN "agent_workflow_run_steps"."handoff_reason" IS NULL
            WHEN 'full'     THEN "agent_workflow_run_steps"."handoff_reason" IS NULL
            WHEN 'degraded' THEN "agent_workflow_run_steps"."handoff_reason" IS NOT NULL
            ELSE false
          END

ck_agent_workflow_runs_state_fields.name: ck_agent_workflow_runs_state_fields
ck_agent_workflow_runs_state_fields.value:
CASE "agent_workflow_runs"."state"
            WHEN 'running'   THEN "agent_workflow_runs"."halt_reason" IS NULL     AND "agent_workflow_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL
            WHEN 'halted'    THEN "agent_workflow_runs"."halt_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "agent_workflow_runs"."completed_at" IS NULL
            WHEN 'completed' THEN "agent_workflow_runs"."halt_reason" IS NULL     AND "agent_workflow_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
            WHEN 'stopped'   THEN "agent_workflow_runs"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL
            ELSE false
          END

ck_agents_scope_target.name: ck_agents_scope_target
ck_agents_scope_target.value:
CASE "agents"."scope"
            WHEN 'global'  THEN "agents"."project_id" IS NULL AND "agents"."session_id" IS NULL
            WHEN 'project' THEN "agents"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agents"."session_id" IS NULL
            WHEN 'session' THEN "agents"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "agents"."project_id" IS NULL
            ELSE false
          END

ck_api_tokens_scopes.name: ck_api_tokens_scopes
ck_api_tokens_scopes.value: cardinality("api_tokens"."scopes") >= 1 AND "api_tokens"."scopes" <@ ARRAY['full', 'ingest']::text[] AND array_position("api_tokens"."scopes", NULL::text) IS NULL

ck_memory_items_tier_scope.name: ck_memory_items_tier_scope
ck_memory_items_tier_scope.value:
CASE "memory_items"."tier"
            WHEN 'session' THEN "memory_items"."session_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_items"."agent_id" IS NULL
            WHEN 'project' THEN "memory_items"."project_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_items"."session_id" IS NULL AND "memory_items"."agent_id" IS NULL
            WHEN 'agent'   THEN "memory_items"."agent_id" IS NOT NULL AND "memory_items"."session_id" IS NULL
            WHEN 'global'  THEN "memory_items"."project_id" IS NULL AND "memory_items"."session_id" IS NULL AND "memory_items"."agent_id" IS NULL
            ELSE false
          END

ck_memory_items_source_identity.name: ck_memory_items_source_identity
ck_memory_items_source_identity.value: ("memory_items"."source_id" IS NOT NULL) <> ("memory_items"."source_ref" IS NOT NULL)

ck_memory_items_source_ref_length.name: ck_memory_items_source_ref_length
ck_memory_items_source_ref_length.value: "memory_items"."source_ref" IS NULL OR length("memory_items"."source_ref") BETWEEN 1 AND 1024

ck_memory_items_content_presence.name: ck_memory_items_content_presence
ck_memory_items_content_presence.value: "memory_items"."content" IS NOT NULL OR "memory_items"."source_ref" IS NOT NULL

ck_settings_value_matches_type.name: ck_settings_value_matches_type
ck_settings_value_matches_type.value:
("settings"."value_type" = 'string'  AND jsonb_typeof("settings"."value") = 'string')  OR
    ("settings"."value_type" = 'number'  AND jsonb_typeof("settings"."value") = 'number')  OR
    ("settings"."value_type" = 'boolean' AND jsonb_typeof("settings"."value") = 'boolean') OR
    ("settings"."value_type" = 'object'  AND jsonb_typeof("settings"."value") = 'object')  OR
    ("settings"."value_type" = 'array'   AND jsonb_typeof("settings"."value") = 'array')
